courses.note: Elective, not required: the four-year plan has only generic CSC 4xxx elective slots. CSC 4810 is the AI course on the department two-year schedule; CSC 4850 Machine Learning is also offered (a Fall 2025 syllabus exists only on Studocu, not collected). The Spring 2023 syllabus is the newest public one found; it has a general Academic Honesty Policy reference and no rule on AI tools. No 2025-26 syllabus found.

notes: Course numbers come from the department four-year plan of study (CSC 4520 is the only algorithms course listed). Search engines mostly returned Georgia Tech and Georgia College & State University pages, which were ignored. C5 (CSC 4810 Artificial Intelligence, elective) and C6 (CSC 4320 Operating Systems, one of two required alternatives) were added later from the department two-year course schedule and the four-year plan. A public Fall 2024 CSC 4520 syllabus exists at https://murraypatterson.github.io/fall2024/syllabus.pdf (not added to C3, which was left unchanged).
